title: An Elemental Ethics for Artificial Intelligence: Water as Resistance Within AI’s Value Chain
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to developing and proposing a new ethical framework ('elemental ethics') for Artificial Intelligence. It engages deeply with moral philosophies like utilitarianism and care ethics, as well as Indigenous spiritual traditions and cosmologies, such as the sacred status of water ('puri') and land ('Pachamama') for the Lickan Antay people.
